videoUrls.title: YouTube URLs or video IDs
videoUrls.description: Any YouTube link format works: watch?v=, youtu.be, /shorts/, /embed/, /live/, or a bare 11-character video ID.

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: Language code to prefer, e.g. en, de, uk, es. Empty = the video's original language. If the requested language does not exist, the original track is used.

preferManualCaptions.title: Prefer human-written captions
preferManualCaptions.description: true = use the uploader's captions when they exist and auto-generated speech recognition only as a fallback. false = the other way round.

includeSegments.title: Include timestamped segments
includeSegments.description: true = every caption cue with start time and duration, next to the full plain text.

maxVideos.title: Max videos per run
maxVideos.description: Safety stop: the run never processes more than this many videos.

cacheMinutes.title: Reuse a transcript for this many minutes
cacheMinutes.description: A video already fetched in this window is served from this account's own cache: instant answer, and no second request to YouTube for the same video. 0 = always fetch live. Default 720 (12 hours).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: YouTube rate-limits data-centre addresses. If you see LOGIN_REQUIRED for videos that clearly have captions, switch this on and pick residential proxies.
